task_2.harness_source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Simple test harness for program.py.
Runs three tests: inputs/input1.txt, inputs/input2.txt, inputs/input3.txt
Compares program stdout to expected files. Exits 0 iff all tests pass.
"""
import subprocess
import sys
import os

tests = [
    ("inputs/input1.txt", "expected/expected1.txt"),
    ("inputs/input2.txt", "expected/expected2.txt"),
    ("inputs/input3.txt", "expected/expected3.txt"),
]

all_passed = True
results = []
print("Running tests...")
for i, (inp, exp) in enumerate(tests, start=1):
    print(f"Test {i}: {inp} -> running program...")
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "program.py", inp], capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = proc.stdout
    err = proc.stderr
    rc = proc.returncode

    # Read expected output
    with open(exp, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        expected = f.read()

    # Normalize by splitting into lines and stripping trailing CRLF differences
    out_lines = [ln.rstrip('\r') for ln in out.splitlines()]
    exp_lines = [ln.rstrip('\r') for ln in expected.splitlines()]

    passed = (rc == 0) and (out_lines == exp_lines)
    note = ""
    if rc != 0:
        note = f"program exited with code {rc}. stderr:\n{err}"
    elif out_lines != exp_lines:
        note = "Output does not match expected exactly.\n--- program stdout ---\n" + out + "--- expected ---\n" + expected

    results.append({
        'input': inp,
        'expected': exp,
        'passed': passed,
        'returncode': rc,
        'stderr': err,
        'note': note,
    })

    if passed:
        print(f"Test {i}: {inp} -> PASS")
    else:
        print(f"Test {i}: {inp} -> FAIL")
        if note:
            print("  Reason:")
            for line in note.splitlines():
                print("    " + line)
        all_passed = False

print(f"All tests completed: {sum(1 for r in results if r['passed'])}/{len(results)} passed")
if not all_passed:
    print("Exiting with failure (1)")
    sys.exit(1)
print("All tests passed. Exiting with success (0)")
sys.exit(0)

task_3.diagnosis: The program does not skip empty/blank lines. When the input contains a blank line, line.split(',') produces [''] and accessing parts[1] raises IndexError: list index out of range. Root cause: missing guard to ignore empty lines before splitting/processing.
